description: Representative LaMont will be attending the 5th Annual Indigenous Peoples' Day Rocks (IPD Rocks) on Saturday, October 5, 2024 at The Current in Stowe, Vermont will feature Grammy nominated Baton Rouge bluesman Kenny Neal, Vermont's own electrifying singer Dave Keller, and DC's Queen of the Blues ~ C
title: Indigenous Peoples’ Day Rocks! — Saudia LaMont for Vermont
